cohort: 200 women with a history of one prior lower segment caesarean section and term singleton pregnancies were enrolled.
finding: VBAC is a viable and safe alternative to ELSCS when proper case selection and intrapartum monitoring are ensured, potentially reducing caesarean-related morbidity and healthcare costs in India.
mod_finding: VBAC was successful in 78% of cases, with significantly lower maternal complications (febrile morbidity, hospital stay) and earlier initiation of breastfeeding compared to ELSCS, though uterine rupture occurred in 1% of VBAC cases.
